lastCompletedStory.title: CHANGELOG release-section roll (Unreleased -> versioned, fresh Unreleased)

nextStoryContext: US-004 added rollChangelog() in src/release/changelog.ts (pure string-in/string-out transform: finds '## [Unreleased]', inserts fresh empty '## [Unreleased]' above, renames old heading to '## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD'). The bump step (ship-bump.ts) now reads CHANGELOG.md via readChangelog(), calls rollChangelog() with newVersion and dateStr (clock().slice(0,10)), writes via writeChangelog(), and includes CHANGELOG.md in the git add call. ShipBumpOptions gained readChangelog/writeChangelog. _buildBumpOpts in index.ts wires real fs calls. All 1480 tests pass. The next story (US-005 or higher priority) can import rollChangelog from src/release/changelog.ts if it needs to inspect or extend the CHANGELOG transform logic.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-004 only uses pure JS string operations (indexOf, slice, template literals). No external npm library was touched; no fetch needed.
